
add_driver_inf(ac97 ac97.inf)

# ac97.sys is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/ac97-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(ac97_shims OBJECT adapter.cpp common.cpp mintopo.cpp prophnd.cpp miniport.cpp stream.cpp stream2.cpp rtminiport.cpp rtstream.cpp wavepciminiport.cpp wavepcistream.cpp wavecyclicminiport.cpp wavecyclicstream.cpp)
target_link_libraries(ac97_shims PRIVATE stdunk libcntpr uuid libportcls libhal libntoskrnl)
if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "GNU" OR CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "Clang")
    target_compile_options(ac97_shims PRIVATE -Wno-write-strings -Wno-switch)
endif()
add_cargo_module(ac97 ac97-cargo ac97.sys
    KIND wdmdriver
    DESTINATION reactos/system32/drivers
    EXTRA_DEPENDS ac97_shims psdk asm uuid_sources xdk)
